description.narrative: Georgia Renewable Power Operations JSC (GRPO, the Issuer), a renewable energy affiliate of Georgia Capital PLC (GCAP, the Sponsor), being established following GCAPs strategic decision to separate and demerge its renewable energy business from Georgia Global Utilities JSC (GGU) and consolidate operational renewable energy assets, including four hydropower and one wind power plant of total 71 MW installed capacity, under GRPO.

The Project raises financing through a green bond issuance to refinance existing liabilities which were used for redeeming a portion of the US$250 million Eurobond issued in 2020 by GGU. The Project will help GCAP to support GRPOs core business and new renewable energy investments. The debt refinancing supported by the Project unlocks risk capital from the Sponsor to develop renewable energy projects. The main expected project-level outcomes are the positive environmental effects derived from increasing renewable energy capacity in Georgia and facilitate renewable energy supply to meet growing demand in Georgia. At a market level, the investment increases financial integration of Georgias infrastructure corporates to capital markets and contributes to develop domestic capital market through demonstration effects.
